# AEC Model Bridge

> Open-source Revit MCP server (Model Context Protocol) and native Revit add-in. AI assistants such as Claude, Codex and Cursor read and edit the BIM model open in Revit 2024 to 2027. Every model change is a plan that a person approves first (approval gate). Also reads IFC files; Rhino, Grasshopper and Speckle integrations included.

- Protocol: Model Context Protocol, stdio transport. Any MCP client that can start a local server works.
- Tools: 320 in the default setup, counted in mock mode. Revit has 112 of them.
- Safety: tools that change the model are blocked until a plan is approved. An unattended mode exists and is opt-in.
- Platform: live Revit work needs Windows and a licensed Revit. Mock mode (sample data) needs neither.
- Licence: GPL-3.0-or-later with the Revit Linking Exception, plus a commercial option.

## Use it

- [README](https://github.com/Sam-AEC/aec-model-bridge/blob/main/README.md): what it does, quick start, one-click install for VS Code, Cursor and Claude Desktop.
- [Install guide](https://github.com/Sam-AEC/aec-model-bridge/blob/main/docs/install.md): installer, source install, MCP client config, bridge health check, mock mode.
- [Other MCP clients](https://github.com/Sam-AEC/aec-model-bridge/blob/main/docs/clients.md): config for Codex, Gemini CLI, JetBrains, Visual Studio, Windsurf and Cline.
- [Compatibility](https://github.com/Sam-AEC/aec-model-bridge/blob/main/docs/compatibility.md): tested clients, agent frameworks, applications and file formats (IFC, BCF).
- [Run beside Autodesk's Revit MCP server](https://github.com/Sam-AEC/aec-model-bridge/blob/main/docs/run-beside-autodesk-revit-mcp.md): tool name prefixes and a two-server client configuration (UNVERIFIED).
- [Tool catalog](https://github.com/Sam-AEC/aec-model-bridge/blob/main/docs/tools-generated.md): every tool with its read or write flag.
- [Prompt library](https://github.com/Sam-AEC/aec-model-bridge/blob/main/docs/prompts/README.md): 53 copy-ready prompts for BIM coordinators, each mapped to tools and the approval flow.
- [Configuration reference](https://github.com/Sam-AEC/aec-model-bridge/blob/main/docs/configuration-reference.md): environment variables, runtime modes, approval modes.
- [Troubleshooting](https://github.com/Sam-AEC/aec-model-bridge/blob/main/docs/troubleshooting.md): log locations, connection, approval and install errors, panel Setup check.
- [Error catalogue](https://github.com/Sam-AEC/aec-model-bridge/blob/main/docs/error-catalogue.md): every error kind and exception class the server returns, when it happens and what to do.
- [Full text](https://github.com/Sam-AEC/aec-model-bridge/blob/main/llms-full.txt): this file and the agent docs it links, in one file.

## Approval and safety

- [Approval gate lifecycle](https://github.com/Sam-AEC/aec-model-bridge/blob/main/docs/adr/0008-approval-gate-lifecycle.md): plan, review, approve, execute, roll back.
- [Security model](https://github.com/Sam-AEC/aec-model-bridge/blob/main/docs/security.md): trust boundaries, panel token, workspace sandbox, what the gate does not protect.
- [Proof bundles and revert plans](https://github.com/Sam-AEC/aec-model-bridge/blob/main/docs/proof-and-revert.md): what is recorded for each executed plan and how to undo it.
- [Logging and audit](https://github.com/Sam-AEC/aec-model-bridge/blob/main/docs/logging-and-audit.md): audit log format and redaction.
- [Privacy](https://github.com/Sam-AEC/aec-model-bridge/blob/main/docs/privacy.md): what leaves the machine.

## Extend and build

- [Architecture](https://github.com/Sam-AEC/aec-model-bridge/blob/main/docs/adr/0001-multi-provider-architecture.md): providers, modules and the Revit bridge.
- [Module authoring](https://github.com/Sam-AEC/aec-model-bridge/blob/main/docs/module-authoring.md): write a plug-in module.
- [Rule packs](https://github.com/Sam-AEC/aec-model-bridge/blob/main/docs/rule-packs.md): BIM QA/QC rules.
- [MCP token budget](https://github.com/Sam-AEC/aec-model-bridge/blob/main/docs/mcp-token-budget.md): tool profiles and context size.
- [Performance](https://github.com/Sam-AEC/aec-model-bridge/blob/main/docs/performance.md): server cold start, bridge client compression and routing, `revit_perf_report`.
- [Deferred tool loading](https://github.com/Sam-AEC/aec-model-bridge/blob/main/docs/deferred-tool-loading.md): Claude Code and Claude API config that defers the server behind tool search and keeps eight tools loaded.
- [Python automation](https://github.com/Sam-AEC/aec-model-bridge/blob/main/docs/python-automation.md): fast revit_execute_python patterns and the opt-in `amb` helper library (`helpers: true`).
- [snapshot_compute](https://github.com/Sam-AEC/aec-model-bridge/blob/main/docs/snapshot-compute.md): one-call read-only query pipelines over a saved snapshot.
- [Read result cursors](https://github.com/Sam-AEC/aec-model-bridge/blob/main/docs/read-cursors.md): size cap, cursors and saved results for large read answers.
- [Operator skill](https://github.com/Sam-AEC/aec-model-bridge/blob/main/packages/claude-plugin/skills/aec-model-bridge/SKILL.md): Agent Skills file that teaches clients to use few calls and small results.
- [Dev workflow](https://github.com/Sam-AEC/aec-model-bridge/blob/main/docs/dev-workflow.md): build, test and release commands.
- [Record and replay](https://github.com/Sam-AEC/aec-model-bridge/blob/main/docs/record-replay.md): record bridge traffic to a cassette and replay it without Revit as a regression test.
- [Agent instructions](https://github.com/Sam-AEC/aec-model-bridge/blob/main/AGENTS.md): repository layout, commands and rules for coding agents.
